structure_notes: The source is a hands-only tabletop advert with no visible face.
New visual evidence arrives every one to two seconds through product, pour, case, label and texture close-ups.
The adaptation retains the product-to-use, quantity-to-label, proof-to-pour and value-recap relationships while discarding the source brand, gift packaging and unsupported claims.
No source-derived frame may be used as an ImageGen or H3 reference.

beats.visual_action: A chilled bottle rotates to the front label, then liquid pours into a bowl and a spoon lifts it.
beats.visual_sync: The product name lands as the shot changes from the front label to visible use.

beats.visual_action: A case opens to reveal six bottles, then one bottle is lifted toward the camera.
beats.visual_sync: The quantity claim lands on the overhead six-bottle view.

beats.visual_action: The back label fills the frame, followed by a liquid insert, the front label and a cap-removal setup.
beats.visual_sync: Ingredient and number statements appear with readable package evidence.

beats.visual_action: The opened product pours into a clear vessel and the filled result is shown close to camera.
beats.visual_sync: A verified nutrition fact is spoken while the product is visibly poured.

beats.visual_action: Multiple packages and the prepared drink resolve into a final product-and-result composition.
beats.visual_sync: Capacity, servings and operator-confirmed unit price land on the final front-label hero.
